description.en: A frozen pane of ice over your live HTML that melts under the cursor and refreezes.
description.zh: 在实时 HTML 上覆盖冰层，光标划过时融化，离开后重新结冰。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获，先查看详情中的浏览器要求与回退说明。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: Base frozen coverage added on top of the frost pattern.
description.zh: 在冰霜图案上叠加的基础冻结覆盖量。

description.en: Multiplier on the frost noise pattern. Higher freezes more.
description.zh: 冰霜噪声图案的倍数，值越高冻结越多。

description.en: Contrast of the frost noise pattern.
description.zh: 冰霜噪声图案的对比度。

description.en: Contrast of the final frost mask. Higher is crisper edges.
description.zh: 最终冰霜遮罩的对比度，值越高边缘越清晰。

description.en: How much sparkling grain mixes into the frost.
description.zh: 混入冰霜的闪烁颗粒量。

description.en: How strongly the sparkles tint toward white.
description.zh: 闪光趋向白色的着色强度。

description.en: Base blur haze over the content, even outside thick frost.
description.zh: 内容上方的基础模糊雾层，即使不在厚霜区域也存在。

description.en: Frost color where the layer is thin, as [r, g, b] in 0-1.
description.zh: 薄冰霜区域的颜色，使用 [r, g, b]，范围为 0 至 1。

description.en: Frost color where the layer is thick, as [r, g, b] in 0-1.
description.zh: 厚冰霜区域的颜色，使用 [r, g, b]，范围为 0 至 1。

description.en: How much the frost tint colors the frozen areas.
description.zh: 冰霜着色影响冻结区域的程度。

description.en: Saturation multiplier applied to the frosted content.
description.zh: 冰霜下内容的饱和度倍数。

description.en: Brightness multiplier applied to the frosted content.
description.zh: 冰霜下内容的亮度倍数。

description.en: How far the icy surface bends light. 0 disables it.
description.zh: 冰面弯折光线的程度，0 关闭。

description.en: Index of refraction of the ice. Water ice is about 1.31.
description.zh: 冰的折射率，水冰约为 1.31。

description.en: Strength of the fine surface detail in the refraction.
description.zh: 折射中细微表面细节的强度。

description.en: Scale of the icy relief pattern. Higher is larger features.
description.zh: 冰面浮雕图案的缩放，值越高特征越大。

description.en: Fresnel boost of the refraction at grazing angles.
description.zh: 掠射角下折射的菲涅耳增强程度。

description.en: Radius of the melt spot under the cursor.
description.zh: 光标下方融化区域的半径。

description.en: Irregularity of the melt edge. 0 is a clean circle.
description.zh: 融化边缘的不规则程度，0 为完整圆形。

description.en: How quickly hovering melts the frost.
description.zh: 悬停融化冰霜的速度。

description.en: How fast melted areas freeze back over. 0 never refreezes.
description.zh: 已融化区域重新冻结的速度，0 表示不再冻结。

description.en: Keeps the edges of the pane frozen. 0 lets everything melt.
description.zh: 保持冰面边缘冻结的强度，0 允许全部融化。

description.en: Lets the frozen borders of the pane melt too.
description.zh: 允许冰面的冻结边缘也融化。

description.en: Seconds for the frost to grow in from the edges on load. 0 disables.
description.zh: 加载时冰霜从边缘生长所需的秒数，0 关闭。

description.en: Overall opacity of the frost layer. Lower shows more content.
description.zh: 冰霜层的整体透明度，值越低显示的内容越多。

description.en: Animated twinkle of the highlight grain. 0 is static.
description.zh: 高光颗粒的动态闪烁，0 为静态。

description.en: Resolution multiplier for the blur passes (0.25-1).
description.zh: 模糊渲染的分辨率倍数（0.25 至 1）。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
